text: At its meeting on June 22, 2026, the Housing Rights Advisory Committee considered Item HS12.3 and made recommendations to the Executive Committee. Summary from the Housing Rights Advisory Committee: In response to HS11.3 , the Chair of the Housing Rights Advisory Committee will highlight the actions and accomplishments of the committee’s first term and will also summarize key priorities identified by the committee should the committee be reestablished for a second term during the next Council term.
The Executive Committee: 1. Received the Item for information.
